extDesc.message: Adjust the volume of each browser tab independently, from 0% up to 999%. Scroll the wheel inside the panel to control in real time.

extDefaultTitle.message: Tab Volume 999 · Click, then scroll to adjust volume

hintText.message: Affects only this tab · Scroll wheel to adjust

infoAbout1.message: Only adjusts the current tab's volume; every tab is independent and unaffected by others.

infoAbout2.message: Captures all audio of the tab (WebAudio and any player included), from 0% to 999%.

infoAbout3.message: 100% sits at the center of the gauge and slider; wheel step ±5% (hold left button ±20%).

infoAbout4.message: Above ~200%, audio becomes noticeably distorted (a physical limit of gain amplification).

infoAbout5.message: Browser built-in pages (edge://, Web Store, PDF viewer, etc.) cannot be captured.

infoAbout6.message: Requires the tabCapture permission (shown as "Capture screen content" at install).

infoLatencyNote.message: When adjusting, audio passes through a capture → playback pipeline with buffering at each hop:

infoLatency1.message: Total ~20–50ms; common to all such extensions and cannot be removed at the code level.

infoLatency2.message: At 100% volume (or after "Release"), audio bypasses the pipeline and plays natively with zero latency.

errMissingParams.message: Invalid parameters: missing tabId or streamId

offscreenJustification.message: Plays back the captured audio of tabs and applies Web Audio gain (0% ~ 999%).

errAlreadyCaptured.message: This tab is already being captured (by this or another extension) and cannot be captured again

errNotAllowed.message: The browser denied audio capture (please check permission settings)

errNotSupported.message: This browser does not support this capture method
